label: Phase 002 dual placement is required: the semantic lane uses the handler embedding only on exact prompt equality and returns [] on a miss. But under vitest the embedding wrapper returns run() without embedding and the lane uses fixtureVector of the scored text, so T004, GATES and the corpus gates all pass even for a scorer-only strip. CHANGE: T013 must check that the live probe of the stripped prompt still shows a non-empty semantic-lane contribution.

The handler-plus-scorer-entry placement is correct but not the only correct one: stripping inside withSemanticShadowPromptEmbedding plus the scorer entry would also keep the embedding key and the scored text equal, at worse cohesion. Stripping the cache key is optional for correctness. KEEP the plan's placement.

The handler still passes the raw prompt to enrichCompiledRoutes at :563 and :638, so a pasted reply that names a slash command may still surface a compiled route after the strip (inferred). CHANGE: add one compiled-route leakage probe to T013, with no code change in phase 002.

Across 701 prompt lines in 8 corpus files, rg finds zero reported-speech cues and zero now/task/next/then colon markers, so REQ-004's 0-match count passes trivially and proves nothing about precision. CHANGE: T002's one-liner adds 4 to 6 inline negative near-miss cases instead of new corpus rows.

Smallest rule (inferred, not executed): anchored at the start, a reported-speech cue or a leading quote, stripped through the first now:/task: marker; return the input unchanged when the remainder is empty; leave then:/next: out of the marker set. One pass is not idempotent for a nested paste, so T002 must test the nested case and name it. KEEP the T002 candidate with these cases added.
